data.gender_notes: Dhina is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Dhina represents the divine feminine power and strength. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'dhana' which means 'wealth' or 'prosperity'. In Hindu mythology, Dhina is also associated with the goddess Durga, who is revered as the embodiment of feminine power and strength. The name Dhina carries the meaning “Feminine power, strength” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil, Telugu. Parents who choose Dhina usually hope their child will grow to embody feminine power, strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Dhina belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Feminine power, strength.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dhina total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
